style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly resting on weathered concrete. extreme asymmetry with off-centre hero object. three recognisable engineered parts: a large modular server housing that is physically split and darkened, sitting next to a completely detached, intact solid-state backup drive module placed far to the right edge. the parts are arranged in a clear physical separation that states the idea of remote, disconnected storage. matte surfaces with moulding seams and deep contact shadows resting on the concrete, one directional key light raking across them from the left, throwing long cast shadows. matte muted palette of charcoal grey and stark white. no plain spheres or wedges, no text, no moulded lettering.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random lettering, watermarks, UI, labels, typography, print
rationale: A clay render perfectly captures the structural reality of regional cloud architecture and the physical severing of data availability, using a stark, tactile assembly of recognizable modular parts.
subject: a severed modular data storage block with an isolated intact backup drive
core_thesis: A cloud region can be permanently unrecoverable, making an external, out-of-provider backup the only true guarantee of data survival.
core_conflict: Regional redundancy vs catastrophic physical loss
composition: extreme asymmetry with off-centre hero object
